DX launches hyperlocal capability for DX SameDay service

DX, a leading provider of logistics solutions across parcel, freight, fulfilment and final mile, today announces the addition of a new hyperlocal capability to its DX SameDay service. DX SameDay provides a nationwide, same-day delivery service, operating 24 hours a day, 365 days a year, facilitating both planned and time-critical delivery requirements. The new hyperlocal capability extends the service for those customers with short-distance, high-volume or multi-site delivery requirements.

DX SameDay's hyperlocal capability is underpinned by significant investment in the network's infrastructure. This new element of the service can support both regular deliveries, between multiple locations in close proximity, as well as one-off consignments.

The service can be accessed via the DX Logistics website, telephone or email channels, and collections are guaranteed within 60 minutes of booking confirmation for suitable vehicle types. Deliveries are GPS tracked and actively monitored throughout, providing customers with visibility of each consignment and proof of delivery in real time.

Since its launch, DX SameDay has been used by businesses as a premium delivery solution, which in turn supports the experience they are able to provide to their own customers. DX SameDay is offered as part of DX's wider logistics capabilities, enabling customers to consolidate more of their logistics requirements with one partner.
Steve Bescoby, Managing Director of DX SameDay, commented:

"Same-day delivery is evolving. For many businesses, it is no longer reserved for exceptional or time-critical requirements. It is increasingly becoming part of how they manage day-to-day operations, particularly across multi-site locations.

"Our investment in hyperlocal capability reflects that evolution. It gives us the ability to apply the responsiveness and visibility of DX SameDay to shorter-distance, higher-volume delivery requirements, and opens up more ways for our customers to use the service.
"Ultimately, we want DX SameDay to become an integral part of how our customers deliver for their customers."

About DX
www.dxlogistics.com

DX is a leading provider of logistics solutions, supporting business and residential customers across the UK and Ireland. With a heritage dating back to 1975, DX has grown into a multi-service logistics business, offering a comprehensive portfolio that includes Freight, Parcel, Fulfilment, Document, Final Mile and Integrated solutions.

The Company combines national scale with service precision, helping customers manage complex supply chain needs, from first-mile collection to warehousing, scheduled and express delivery, and final-mile fulfilment. Its network is built to serve sectors where timing, security and reliability are critical.

DX operates from over 120 sites and employs more than 5,000 colleagues. The business is focused on expanding its reach, enhancing its service proposition and investing in the technology, infrastructure and talent needed to deliver long-term value for its customers.
